record.interfaces_live_at: the top-level `interfaces` key, per ce-parts/SCHEMA.md v2.4 (b) which cites `interfaces[0]`. The duplicate `record.interfaces` was removed 2026-09-02 (lane T) after `bin/triad check` FAILed the folder for carrying two spellings of one fact.

interfaces.name: shell_screws
interfaces.what: the three screws that close the head: Ø2.1000 x 11.2000 thread-forming pilots at (x, y) = (0.0000, 49.5000), (39.0000, -49.5000) and (-39.0000, -49.5000), each entered through a Ø2.8000 x 0.8000 counterbore, all axis z. Pilot centres z 9.6000 (span z 4.0000..15.2000); counterbore centres z 3.6000 (span z 3.2000..4.0000), so the seating plane is z 4.0000 and the frame origin is the counterbore mouth. Fit residual 0.0000 mm at 355.0 deg on all six. The three positions lie on a Ø112.1175 circle and match part:microduck-bottom-head-shell 'head_shell_screws' — Ø2.6950 x 2.0040 clearance at the SAME three (x, y), fitted independently on the other mesh.

interfaces.name: beak_envelope
interfaces.what: the shell's own extent, declared as an interface because it is the number that BLOCKS this part: bbox x -45.8797..45.8798, y -66.1900..56.5000, z -0.0014..46.3348 = 91.7595 x 122.6900 x 46.3361 mm. Frame origin is the bbox centre in x and y on the z=0 datum plane. COMPARISON.html finding 1 is measured against this row: 122.6900 mm front-to-back is far longer than the compact domed head in every product photograph (images/store/*), and no eye bezel is modelled here at all. Any tooling cut from this mesh is wrong. This row exists so that the envelope has a number a replacement can be graded against; it accepts no connection because it is not a joint.
